Leave-alone objects (joint frames, shared/mixed-point, ternary, parity-side, DisjointTensor.frame_data, verify_factor, leech_minor, sparse-fusion, joint-dual replay, bit-frame frameopt.close, quadratic-affine) and deferred micro-opts were not reopened.

ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance for orientation, overlap search, profiling, production wiring, packaging, benchmarking and writing
evidence: PASS_R420_RREF_PRODUCTION via research/r420-rref-production/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_IDENTICAL_R420_RREF_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS via benchmark.py; MANIFEST.sha256 binds the production xcheck digest; identical check and mutants stdout digests.
